description: The sum of the digits of n each raised to k. 0 to any k from 1 up is 0. 153 to the 3 is 153. 4150 to the 5 is 4150, and 4150 to the 4 is 882. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999 and k runs from 1 to 15. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/digit-power-sum
